Hello Chimor, I see you have been added into Erene and you are nestled deep within Vespuria, but I also notice that the only way to get to the rest of the world and ocean trade is by going through UREV waters. I have a deal, quite a nice one which I think benefits us both.

How about this: 
In exchange for me giving you tax-free passage through my waters as well as allowing your military ships to freely move through my waters, you will begin to trade with me and have your economy more connected with mine. As well as you will begin to support and back UREV fully diplomatically, economically, and militarily. So for you being able to use my waters tax-free and being able to go into open ocean, all I ask in return is your unconditional support and trade. I can also promise to defend you and your sovereignty, so nobody can threaten you.

Plus we can establish an embassy between us.
